section: Do you really think it was

conversation.speaker: dialogue
conversation.text:
Police: Do you really think Mr. Jin Kangshi took the child away?
Respondent: Well:
Respondent: Was it really him? Do you think he did it? No matter what, that’s not his personality.
Respondent: There is someone else...
Respondent: Officer Quan, I’m not trying to clear Jin Kangshi of suspicion. I just want to tell you what I saw.
Respondent: There is a woman who often wanders around near that amusement park.
Respondent: Whenever I went to look for Xiyuan, I would see her every time I passed by there.
Respondent: She looks to be in her thirties or forties, and she’s quite tall... probably about 10 centimeters taller than me.
Respondent: That woman often stares toward the amusement park.
Respondent: The place where she stands is a little distance from the amusement park, and there are flowers blocking the view, so she’s not easily noticed. But if someone is tall enough, they can see the amusement park from there.
Respondent: That woman often stands there on tiptoe, looking past the flower bed.
Respondent: ...By the way, Officer Quan.
Respondent: What is the name of the child Kangshi took away?
